messages:
Nora (CS): Quick kickoff: Voyager signed a 90-day Dedicated pilot. Need compact owner list, top success signals (procurement cares about renewal by week 7), and a 30-day runbook. Sam can you confirm staging ETA?
Sam (Solutions): Staging pool ready in eu-west-1, endpoint by Day 3. I'll post the access ACL + peering form today.
Ibrahim (Voyager): Thanks. Requirements: EU data residency, Okta SSO, and audit logs retention for 90 days. Procurement asked for a simple ROI metric by week 6.
Kait (Eng): Noted. Perf targets I propose: p50 <150ms, p95 <400ms at 3 RPS. We'll also enable prefix caching for recurring prompts.
Jon (CS Programs): I can prepare the ROI one-pager and the enablement lab plan. Recommend 2 enablement sessions: power users + dev integration.
Nora (CS): Draft success signals:
- Connectivity & SSO validated (Day 7)
- Perf baseline recorded and within SLOs (Day 10)
- ROI snapshot (cost per interaction + latency trend) ready by Day 42
- Adoption: 2 power users trained + integration sample app working
Sam (Solutions): Blocker: they need to complete the private peering request. Ibrahim, can you surface the netops contact?
Ibrahim (Voyager): Netops contact is peering@voyager.health. I'll send the filled template today.
Kait (Eng): For long requests (>1024 tokens) we'll propose async batch handling. Real-time path will be capped at 1024.
Nora (CS): 30-day checkpoints:
Day 0: Kickoff + access requests
Day 3: Staging endpoint + smoke tests
Day 7: SSO handshake + security checklist done
Day 10: First perf run + baseline metrics posted
Day 14: Enablement #1 (power users)
Day 21: Integration test with routing & KV cache
Day 30: Exec preview + readiness flag
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Voyager Onboard - Weekly Stand" every Thu 09:30 CET starting 2024-06-20. Invite sent.
Jon (CS Programs): Action items I own: ROI one-pager (5d), enablement slides (7d), NPS-lite feedback form (3d).
Sam (Solutions): I'll upload ACLs & terraform snippet by EOD.
Ibrahim (Voyager): Ok will confirm peering and Okta admin contact (carla@voyager.health).
Kait (Eng): I'll run the Day 10 perf and post logs. If p95 > 450ms we escalate to infra for scaling.
Nora (CS): Owners recap:
- Connectivity & staging: Sam
- Perf & infra tuning: Kait
- Enablement + ROI + feedback: Jon
- Customer PM/liaison: Ibrahim
- Success lead & renewal check: Nora
Nora (CS): I'll publish these kickoff notes + action tracker in the onboarding doc and ping when done: https://redwood.internal/onboard/voyager. Closing thread for now, will reopen with updates.
Ibrahim (Voyager): All good from my side, thanks everyone!
